[[File:Marnya.png|thumb|250px|Marnya]] '''Marnya''' (Japanese: '''マーニャ''' ''Manya'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HZ040|Farewell, Sprigatito?]]''. Marnya is a {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}}, specializing in breeding cat Pokémon. In ''[[HZ040|Farewell, Sprigatito?]]'', Marnya met [[Liko]] recognizing her as a student at [[Indigo Academy]] and as shown in a flashback, she was present during Liko's school interview with
